query: What signals suggest an incident will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: resolution_hours
per_column.rationale: This is resolution time itself expressed in hours (closed_at - opened_at). It is the focus variable restated, and is only knowable after the incident is resolved -- direct leakage.

per_column.name: resolution_hours.1
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of resolution_hours; identical restatement/leakage of the focus variable.

per_column.name: priority_level
per_column.rationale: Derived from priority, known at/near intake, plausibly correlates with resolution time. Legitimate predictor lying outside the focus.

per_column.name: is_critical_high
per_column.rationale: Binary flag on priority severity, available up-front and plausibly predictive of longer resolution. Partly redundant with priority_level but still a valid predictor.

per_column.name: category_complexity
per_column.rationale: Encodes category into a complexity ordinal, known at intake and plausibly related to resolution difficulty. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: same_assignee_caller
per_column.rationale: Constant (0 for all 500 rows), so it carries zero variance and no predictive signal. Not usable as a feature.

per_column.name: updater_is_system
per_column.rationale: Derived from sys_updated_by, which reflects post-hoc update activity during/after handling. Reflects the resolution process rather than an intake-time signal, so it leaks outcome information.

per_column.name: status_risk
per_column.rationale: Derived from state, which changes as the incident progresses and is only settled once resolved/closed. Encodes outcome state -- leakage rather than a pre-outcome predictor.

per_column.name: time_risk
per_column.rationale: A 'time' risk band almost certainly derived from elapsed/resolution timing, i.e., a coarse binning of the focus variable itself. Restatement/leakage.

per_column.name: description_complexity
per_column.rationale: Complexity signal derived from short_description text, available at intake and plausibly correlated with resolution difficulty. Legitimate predictor.

judge.rationale: Of ten added columns, two are direct restatements of the focus (resolution_hours duplicated), three leak outcome/process state (updater_is_system, status_risk, time_risk), and one is a zero-variance constant (same_assignee_caller). Only four -- priority_level, is_critical_high, category_complexity, description_complexity -- are legitimate intake-time predictors, and they are largely simple re-encodings of existing priority/category/description columns, so they add limited genuine leverage beyond the original table. The set is dominated by leakage and redundancy, giving modest overall predictive utility.
